lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns along the lateral flank posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a lattice-like arrangement of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature running across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of low-contrast, high-luminance blobs localized within the lower and posterior regions of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several elongated, low-luminance appendages trailing from the ventral region and the distal margin of the pectoral fin, indicating parasitic or commensal attachments.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of significantly smaller, high-frequency luminance spots on the cranial region and rostrum anterior to the branchial slits.
